goal: Improve the separately measured 100% three-fixture first-score sweep for each competition. All individual R10 first scores, backups, WDL and totals remain as originally issued. Preserve complete eligible pools, missing slots and pending outcomes.
ranking: Control is the original R10 probability of its issued first score. Candidate fits a penalized Bernoulli GLM per competition, using logit(original first-score probability) as fixed offset. Covariates in fixed order: intercept, (p_first/p_three-1/3)*6, both-teams-score indicator, predicted draw indicator, capped total goals in displayed first score (min(total,5)-2)/2, disagreement between point-score WDL and issued WDL, equality between independently issued market first score and candidate first score, market first score missing, prior-shot exposure indicator. Fit ridge penalty 24 for every coefficient, bounds [-1.5,1.5]. No data for a competition gives original probability, and no test-label selection or blending. Ties break by kickoff then event ID for a future slate, by event ID on historical dates without kickoff times.
folds: Using checksum-verified R10 prediction archives: main fits each competition's evaluation fold, tests on strictly later recent fold. Independently, fit pre-2019 predictions in the 2018/19 experiment, test on January 2019 onwards. Elite-only sensitivity fits the 22 older 2026/27 records through October 12, tests the later 55. Historical same-competition/source-calendar-date sibling forecasts constitute a whole candidate pool. Never select across different dates when source predictions could incorporate intervening results. The future comparison uses exactly the complete registered R10 simultaneous slate and its original candidate outcomes. For future weights refit all completed main records per competition; for Elite use its refreshed test-calendar history. Original R10 probabilities were reconstructed using archived categories, whose pregame availability clock is often unknown.
measurement: Per cohort report every eligible date, short/complete batches, selected slots, primary hits, mutual coverage by the displayed three, whole-batch primary sweeps, and date-cluster paired 95% intervals for sweep-rate and selected-seat primary delta. Require three distinct original fixture IDs and three original first-score hits for a sweep. No self-certified stage or promotion; compare against original prospective R10 ranking and keep official comprehensive selections separate.
